# Kahoot!

> > Kahoot! is an interactive learning platform that makes education and workplace training engaging through game-based learning experiences.

Kahoot! provides tools for educators, trainers, and organizations to create interactive quizzes, presentations, and learning games. The platform serves classrooms, corporate training environments, and social learning contexts with features designed to boost engagement and knowledge retention.
